body.p: "Mummy, who is coming, the shoes with embroidery, with iron horns, it sits down on the smoke hole", the child said. The child sailed on the lake, the one with iron horns came, she sat down on the smoke hole. His mother put him [the child] her kettle on the head. The one with iron horns ate the woman and the kettle. Having done so she went to the child. The one with iron horns shouted at the woman's child. The child's father came, he said to this son: "Where has your mother gone?" "A [woman] with iron horns has eaten her". The man married the one with iron horns (it was a woman). Then, having married, the man went to his relatives. The one with iron horns went off, she followed her husband. The one with iron horns caught up her husband. They lit fires, they said to the girls: "Bring new sisters-in-law!" The one with iron horns came to warm herself at the bonfire, they threw silver spoons into the fire, they said: "Which woman is stronger, that one takes the spoon". The new sister-in-law wanted to take it, they pushed her into the fire. Having fallen into the fire, the one with iron horns said: "If you hadn't pushed me, I would have eaten your livers". (???)
